CFTA formalize: source checkpoint c9be731a2a3f554a636ddf3b91b6a647d30e95e1 adds six strict semantic modules (773 lines, 10 public theorems).

Actual flat captured completion now has backward assignment meaning at a derived uniform sufficient bound chosen before the flat input. Actual completed receipt identifies the old canonical complete endpoint, Safe and order. Discharged actual flat rendering and checked returned residuals construct an assignment and derive ORIGINAL CAPTURED edge/parent acceptance at the same captured cache and reached heap. No old successful render, desired assignment or future completed family is an input. Canonical, selected-edge Ranges, nonterminal, fresh arity and retention remain explicit. This does not transport an assignment from a later recursive descendant cache.

Actual native narrowing has exact filtered exposed-edge meaning and result-language inclusion in its original node, including outer Mu/type skips. Independent guarded probes come from Context.ready.semantic.guarded, not Context.probes. Actual recursion parking retains the native handle and clears only the suspended bucket. Original satisfaction iff reached satisfaction AND every removed Suspended.Holds. False checks preserve assignments. Exact law now holds for actual flat checks too. An ancestry key alone has no proved semantic recovery law.

Resource-based traversal semantics retains the ENTIRE existing assignment iff and ordered effective-child-bucket relation, with arbitrary residualMeaning. Original Fits+Reserved(cost inputs)+guard carrier replace universal Traversal.Ranges. Canonical head Post/full Memos/cache/Fits/carrier feed each suffix; concrete leaf Ranges are derived. No arbitrary low-fuel validity or full-bucket strengthening is claimed.

All six modules and Audit pass strict Lean 4.34.1 checks. Aggregate: 4079 jobs, 79129 theorem dependency checks. Installed readback: 12 signatures/axiom lists, 47179 bytes SHA256 86a026efc8fe16c9d1723220ba72ac3e09f391aab33f052cde373c3c411ec174; only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. H6 and older captured-rendering theorem unchanged. No Haskell source changed; FINDINGS preserves all repair handoffs.

Next lift resource semantics through selected/captured edges; compose actual recursive backward histories; recover parked constraints or prove exclusion for relevant finite outputs; derive admission histories and coverage. Whole goal remains active. Handoff: lean/notes-current-recursive-meaning.md. Main remains 82258094c2c32bb93e517427bc649a5c7077adac after pull/fetch.
